description: A bent arm flexing with its fist at the upper left and elbow at the lower right: a bulging biceps curve with a separate muscle line inside and the forearm rising to a clenched fist.
A front-facing head with two curved horns rising outward, long hair falling down both sides to the shoulders, and a rounded face; dense and hard to read.
A heart with two pointed devil horns rising from its top lobes, and a long tail sweeping out from its bottom point to the right and back to an arrowhead tip.
A small front-facing female figure with a round head bearing two short horns, a dress, two bat wings spreading from the shoulders, and a tail curling out on the right to an arrow tip.
A hero's bust from the front: a curled forelock on the forehead, a round face with a smile, and broad shoulders with the top of a chest emblem; dense and hard to read.
A Nintendo Switch tablet tilted up and out of a squat rectangular dock that sits on a base line, with two short lines at the top; the reference is hard to read.
Two tall Joy-Con halves standing side by side with a narrow gap: plain outlines, each with a straight inner edge and a rounded outer edge, without buttons.
A wide rounded handheld console with a large rectangular screen in the centre, a plus-shaped D-pad on the left and a cluster of round buttons on the right.
A large circular ring with two grip pads, one attached at the top holding a small device and one on the left side of the ring.
A foaming beer mug with a handle on the right and a cloudy head overflowing its rim, with a round loaf of bread with two scored lines resting in front at the lower left.
Four small gamepad-like figures in two rows separated by a horizontal divider line: two upside down above with cat-like eared tops, and two below, facing each other across the line.
Two people from the front, shoulder to shoulder, with a single gamepad in front of them at the bottom centre overlapping their bodies.
Two stepped tetromino pieces made of square cells: a large staircase piece at the lower left and a smaller Z-shaped piece at the upper right, fitting toward each other.
A hero's bust from the front: a round cowled head with small wing fins at both ears, a dark goggle-like eye band, a mouth and chin opening, and a round emblem on the chest; hard to read.
A throne from the front: a tall back with a round arched top, broad padded armrests on both sides, a seat crossbar and four straight legs.
